fee_pct.description: Deprecated: fee_pct is the legacy pool swap fee percentage (cosmos.Dec string in [0,1)). Use fee_rate field 11 instead. Migration logic should read this and convert to fee_rate format (two DecCoins, one per reserve denom in canonical order).

min_collateral_ratio.description: Leverage configuration (per-denom) Minimum collateral ratio per reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order; > 1)

max_leverage_ratio.description: Maximum leverage ratio per reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order; > 1)

interest_rate.description: Annual interest rates per reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order).

max_borrow_percent.description: Maximum borrow capacity per reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order). Amounts in [0,1).

liquidation_threshold.description: Collateral ratio liquidation threshold per reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order; each amount is a LegacyDec string > 1)

fee_rate.description: Per-denom swap fee rates (amounts in [0,1)). Allow 0, 1, or 2 entries; keeper normalizes to exactly two entries in canonical pool order. Replaces deprecated fee_pct field 3.

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgUpdatePool.title: Msg Update Pool Config
dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgUpdatePool.description: Update pool config (owner-only: majority of shares > 50%). Notes: - All fields are required. Price bands must be both empty (no band) or both   contain exactly two coins in canonical order matching pool reserves.

cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.title: Coin
cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.description: Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount. NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method signatures required by gogoproto.

cosmos.base.v1beta1.DecCoin.title: Dec Coin
cosmos.base.v1beta1.DecCoin.description: DecCoin defines a token with a denomination and a decimal amount. NOTE: The amount field is an Dec which implements the custom method signatures required by gogoproto.
